name: Sense of Belonging to Math Scale
description: Self-report scale of how much a student feels like an accepted, valued member of the math community. Developed with college students and shown to predict intent to continue in math beyond other predictors.

construct_mapping.note: Recorded by maintainers; awaiting governance committee review.

original_citation.text: Good, C., Rattan, A., & Dweck, C. S. (2012). Why do women opt out? Sense of belonging and women's representation in mathematics. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 102(4), 700-717.

access.terms_summary: Items appear in the APA-published article. Reuse and adaptation terms are not stated in sources read so far. Link to the article; do not copy items.

response_format.notes: Each item follows the stem 'When I am in a math setting'. The library records the 28-item, 6-point form analyzed in the article; the article's appendix prints a 30-item version (adding 'I feel like an outsider' and 'I feel like I fit in') with an 8-point response scale.

scoring.notes: Subscale scores are item means; the composite is the mean of the five subscale means. Negatively worded items are reverse-scored.

citation.text: Good, C., Rattan, A., & Dweck, C. S. (2012). Why do women opt out? Sense of belonging and women's representation in mathematics. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 102(4), 700-717.

needs_check: Check reuse/adaptation terms with APA or the authors.
